This is a hands-on product role at the intersection of AI, commerce, and discoverability. You'll own the roadmap for how e.l.f. shows up, gets cited, and converts inside an ecosystem where shoppers discover, decide, and transact with the help of AI.

You'll work closely with our AEO (Answer Engine Optimization) and GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) team to increase e.l.f.'s visibility, share-of-answer, and citations across generative search and AI assistants (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews, Copilot, Claude). lists.content:
Own the Agentic Commerce roadmap

· Define and maintain the product vision and roadmap for e.l.f.'s Agentic Commerce channels, aligned to business and AI strategy.

· Sequence investment across the discovery-to-purchase path: agent discoverability, product data and content readiness, agent-friendly offers, and agentic checkout flows.

· Manage the product lifecycle end to end — from concept through launch, measurement, and optimization — with tight feedback loops.

 

Drive Agentic visibility with the AEO/GEO team

· Partner with AEO/GEO to grow e.l.f.'s visibility, share-of-answer, and citations across generative search and AI assistants.

· Ensure e.l.f.'s products, content, pricing, and offers are structured so AI agents can access, understand, and act on them accurately.

· Help map the agentic discovery journey — from how LLMs source and retrieve data, to how agents cite and convert — and find where intervention compounds.

· Co-build measurement for agentic visibility (citation tracking, share-of-answer, sentiment by engine) and tie it to commerce outcomes.

 

Support Connected Commerce and CRM for their Agentic needs

· Act as the central product partner for Connected Commerce and CRM teams building agentic capabilities — assessing needs, defining requirements, and setting success measures.

· Enable agent-driven experiences across our commerce stack: agent-readable product/offer data, headless and agentic checkout integrations, and connected journeys bridging discovery, personalization, and conversion.

· Support CRM in orchestrating personalized, agent-mediated customer journeys and lifecycle touchpoints.

· Promote consistency and alignment on the Agentic Commerce approach across teams.

 

Partner cross-functionally and lead execution

· Collaborate with engineering, data science, design, content, analytics, and external partners to evaluate solutions and determine paths to market.

· Write clear product requirements, specs, and acceptance criteria — including prompts, retrieval logic, structured data, and integration details.

· Run experiments, analyze performance, and ship often; make fast, data-informed decisions.

· Identify and mitigate risks to ensure high-quality, responsible, brand-safe delivery.

· Stay ahead of how AI is changing consumer behavior and the agentic ecosystem.

Required

· 5–10 years of relevant experience, with at least 5 years in product management or product ownership owning roadmap, requirements, and delivery.

· Hands-on experience in at least one (ideally more) of: AI products, digital/e-commerce commerce, or AEO/GEO/SEO. Exposure to the agentic commerce landscape and how AI agents impact search, discovery, decisioning, and transaction flows is a strong plus.

· Strong understanding of how AI agents and answer/generative engines surface, cite, and act on content.

· Ability to write clear, detailed requirements and translate between technical (engineering, data, retrieval) and non-technical (marketing, CRM, commerce) stakeholders.

· Analytical and experimentation-driven; comfortable with data, dashboards, and reporting tools (GA, Looker/Tableau, Adobe Analytics).

· Excellent stakeholder management and communication; you influence without authority.

· A builder mindset — you move fast, are comfortable deciding with ~70% of the data, and love shipping.

 

Preferred

· Direct experience with Agentic Commerce, AEO, GEO, or AI-driven search/discovery (in-house or at a platform/agency).

· Familiarity with RAG, vector search, structured data, LLM data sourcing and crawler behavior, and making content agent-readable.

· Experience with agentic commerce frameworks/protocols and agent-based integrations (agent-friendly feeds, headless/agent checkout).

· Experience partnering with Connected Commerce and/or CRM teams on AI-enabled or agentic journeys.

· Background in beauty, retail, consumer goods, or high-velocity DTC/e-commerce.

· Active immersion in the AI and answer-engine ecosystem.

In your first year:

· A clear, prioritized Agentic Commerce roadmap the organization rallies behind.

· Measurable growth in e.l.f.'s visibility, share-of-answer, and citations across key AI assistants and generative search engines — with the AEO/GEO team.

· One or more shipped agentic commerce experiences delivered with Connected Commerce and/or CRM.

· Established credibility as the go-to product partner for Agentic needs across teams.

· A measurable connection between agentic visibility and commerce outcomes.

lists.content:
Global Body Category Brand Strategy

  • Define and own the global brand strategy for the Naturium body category establishing the brand world, narrative architecture, and long-range vision
  • Develop brand positioning, messaging frameworks, and creative territories that are distinctly ownable for body
  • Identify whitespace opportunities in the body category and consumer landscape that the brand can meaningfully own
  • Serve as the global brand authority for body the final word on how the brand shows up across every market, channel, and partner

    • Brand World Building & Integrated Campaigns 

  • Architect the world of Naturium body: the aesthetic, the voice, the values, and the emotional territory the brand inhabits
  • Develop and steward brand guidelines and creative standards that give the body category a coherent, magnetic identity across global touchpoints
  • Shape the cultural brand calendar identifying tentpole moments, cultural conversations, and brand-right opportunities that bring the body world to life
  • Forge brand partnerships, collaborator relationships, and cultural alliances that expand the body brand's universe and deepen consumer connection
  • Champion a brand-first approach to every consumer touchpoint, ensuring the body category has a distinct, consistent presence that is unmistakably Naturium
  • Lead the strategic development of 360° brand campaigns for the body category setting the creative vision, brand narrative, and cultural ambition from brief through execution
  • Partner with Creative, Social, PR, and Media teams to deliver campaigns that are culturally resonant, globally scalable, and unmistakably on-brand
  • Define the strategic role of each campaign moment within the larger brand narrative arc for the year

    • Go-To-Market Vision & Strategy

  • Own the go-to-market vision for the Naturium body category defining annual and seasonal brand strategies that translate global positioning into commercially powerful US market activation
  • Shape the strategic narrative for how the body brand enters, shows up, and wins in the US retail environment across mass, specialty, and DTC
  • Set the strategic direction for key retail brand moments with partners ensuring the body brand shows up with power and coherence at every touchpoint

    • Brand Performance & Insight

  • Manage and optimize regional marketing investment across campaigns, launches, and activations, ensuring strong ROI and disciplined financial stewardship
  • Define brand health metrics and success criteria that measure the strength of the body brand world, not just campaign outputs
  • Leverage consumer, cultural, and competitive intelligence to continuously sharpen brand strategy and GTM vision
  • Build clear, compelling brand narratives for leadership that connect brand equity building to long-range business growth
  • Apply a rigorous, insight-led lens to ensure the body brand strategy remains culturally relevant and commercially sharp

    • Cross-Functional & Enterprise Leadership

  • Act as the strategic center of gravity for the body category aligning Global Brand, Creative, Sales, Retail, Integrated Communications, and Consumer Insights teams around a unified brand vision
  • Champion the consumer and culture at every cross-functional table, ensuring brand decisions are rooted in deep market and human understanding
  • Mentor junior brand talent and cultivate a team culture defined by strategic rigor, creative ambition, and brand obsession

• 8–10+ years of brand strategy, brand management, or integrated brand marketing experience within beauty, personal care, or high-growth consumer brands
  • Proven track record building brand worlds not just executing campaigns with deep experience in brand positioning, architecture, and creative strategy
  • Demonstrated success developing and owning go-to-market brand vision for the US market, including experience with mass, specialty, and DTC retail environments
  • Experience with key US retail partners (Target, Sephora, Ulta, and/or DTC) required
  • Strong understanding of the body care category, consumer behavior, and cultural trends
  • A genuine cultural antenna. You know what's happening in beauty, wellness, and broader culture, and you know how to make a brand part of the conversation
  • Demonstrated ability to influence senior cross-functional and global stakeholders through strategic clarity and compelling brand storytelling
  • Experience working with internal creative teams and external agency partners to deliver high-impact brand work
  • Hands-on experience using or evaluating generative AI tools in a brand or creative strategy context
  • Strong financial acumen with experience managing brand investment and performance metrics
  • Exceptional communicator written, verbal, and visual with the ability to build and sell a brand vision to any audience
  • Highly strategic with strong executional instinct; you can write the brand manifesto and make sure it gets built
  • Ability to travel as business needs require

  • Identify, evaluate, and cultivate relationships with creators across all tiers, from micro and emerging influencers to macro talent and celebrities, with a focus on authenticity, brand alignment, skincare credibility, and long-term partnership potential.
  • Build and maintain trusted relationships with influencers, talent managers, agencies, dermatologists, estheticians, and other key opinion leaders across the skincare and beauty community.
  • Leverage a strong existing network within the creator and talent ecosystem to identify new partnership opportunities, deepen Naturium's cultural relevance, and expand the brand's reach.
  • Develop and oversee innovative, insight-led influencer campaigns that drive awareness, engagement, consideration, and conversion across paid, earned, and organic creator programming.
  • Lead the influencer strategy for creator events, trips, launch activations, and brand experiences, including talent and guest curation, programming, execution, and post-event amplification.

lists.content: As the primary owner of the finished goods quality module, this role takes end-to-end ownership of full-lifecycle finished goods quality management — spanning supplier quality system assessment, supplier capability building and continuous improvement, new product development, pilot production verification, mass production quality control, shipment release, and post-market quality continuous improvement. The position oversees team management, business decision-making, risk control and cross-functional collaboration, ensuring stable, compliant and controllable finished goods quality, and supporting the strategic implementation of the quality department, business development and sustainable high-quality brand development of the company.

1.Strategy Implementation & Process Optimization
  • Translate the company quality strategy and annual targets into detailed execution plans for the finished goods quality team.
  • Establish and continuously optimize the end‑to‑end closed‑loop quality management system covering the full lifecycle of finished goods; define responsibilities, authorities, control standards and operational procedures for each phase, and enable effective execution from strategy to delivery.
  • Continuously improve management and communication workflows to enhance operational efficiency, resolving pain points such as unclear role definition, fragmented multi‑party interfaces and management gaps.
    • 2.End‑to‑End Finished‑Goods Quality Oversight
  • Take overall ownership of quality management across all finished‑goods business modules, covering full‑scope scenarios including supplier quality system assessment and capability enhancement, new product development, pilot‑run validation, mass‑production control, finished‑goods inspection, batch release, non‑conforming material disposition, and closed‑loop resolution of consumer complaints.
  • Design and coordinate workstreams for different business modules within the finished‑goods quality team to achieve resource synergy, and drive standardized, systematic and strategic deployment of quality initiatives.
    • 3.Business Decision‑making and Efficiency Trade‑off
  • Own core quality decisions for the finished‑goods module, including risk assessment of supplier quality systems, quality deviation evaluation, non‑conforming material disposition, as well as risk review and adjudication for potential product quality issues.
  • Govern internal decision‑making criteria, nimbly balance quality compliance baseline against business delivery timelines, and effectively support the company’s business growth requirements.
    • 4.Cross‑Functional Alignment & Stakeholder Liaison
  • Act as the primary internal and external interface for finished‑goods quality; routinely engage key stakeholders including R&D, Procurement, Planning & Logistics, and suppliers to efficiently drive day‑to‑day activities for the quality function.
  • Facilitate communication on new‑product quality design, corrective actions for critical quality issues, closed‑loop management of consumer complaints, and response to finished‑goods supplier quality incidents. Unify communication output criteria to mitigate information discrepancy and improve overall collaboration efficiency.
    • 5.Risk Control & Continuous Improvement
  • Leverage quality KPI monitoring and issue retrospectives to enable proactive risk early‑warning and pre‑emptive intervention, so as to mitigate quality incidents, consumer complaints and brand reputation damage.
  • Lead cross‑functional improvement initiatives for recurrent and systemic quality issues, iterating quality standards and operational procedures on an ongoing basis to deliver sustained and steady improvements in finished‑goods quality.
    • 6.Team Management & Talent Development
  • Take overall charge of day‑to‑day operations of the finished‑goods quality team, including task assignment, priority alignment, progress oversight and performance management.
  • Develop team‑specific skill training frameworks and competency models to target capability gaps, nurture key talents and build up the talent pipeline, and continuously strengthen the team’s professional competence and problem‑solving capabilities.

Minimum request:
  • Bachelor's degree or above in Quality Management, Engineering, Chemistry, or related discipline.
  • 8+ years of quality management experience in finished product quality, supplier quality, or manufacturing quality within FMCG, cosmetics, pharmaceutical, medical device, or related regulated industries.
  • 3+ years of team management experience.
    • Competency:
  • Strong knowledge of quality management systems (ISO 9001, ISO 22716, GMP, or relevant industry standards).
  • Proficiency in quality tools: FMEA, CAPA, root cause analysis, SPC, statistical analysis.
  • Excellent cross-functional communication and stakeholder management skills.
    • Relevant knowledge demand:
  • In-depth understanding of finished goods full-lifecycle quality management.
  • Familiarity with supplier audit and qualification methodologies; Familiar with quality management workflows throughout new‑product development.
  • Data-driven decision-making and risk assessment capabilities.

At e.l.f. Beauty, we believe commerce is no longer a destination, it's an experience. We're looking for an Associate Director, Social & LIVE Commerce to help shape the future of how consumers discover, engage, and shop across social platforms globally.

This role will be responsible for scaling e.l.f.'s rapidly growing social commerce business, with a primary focus on TikTok Shop and LIVE selling across the U.S. and international markets. As a key leader within the Global Social Commerce team, you will drive the strategy, execution, and operational excellence behind LIVE commerce programs that blend entertainment, community, creators, and conversion.

You'll partner cross-functionally across Brand, IMC, Creative, Digital Commerce, Influencer, and external agency partners to build scalable programs that turn launches, cultural moments, and creator communities into measurable business growth.

This role is ideal for a builder who thrives in fast-paced environments, understands both content and commerce, and is hungry to help define the next generation of connected commerce.

Lead e.l.f.'s Global LIVE Commerce Strategy 

  • Own end-to-end LIVE commerce planning, execution, operations, and performance across TikTok Shop and emerging social commerce platforms. 

  • Build and scale recurring weekly LIVE programming and MegaLIVE events that drive audience growth, engagement, and GMV across e.l.f. Cosmetics, e.l.f. SKIN, and future brand categories. 

  • Develop scalable frameworks, ways to win, and operating models that can be replicated globally as social commerce expands internationally. 

  • Drive international TSPs to launch and grow TikTok Shop and LIVE commerce programs in new markets worldwide. 

Drive Go-to-Market Excellence 

  • Lead social commerce activation plans for innovation launches, hero products, Super Brand Days, Hot Drops, New Arrivals, seasonal campaigns, and cultural moments. 

  • Develop merchandising, pricing, promotional, traffic, and content strategies that maximize awareness and conversion. 

  • Brief internal and external teams, ensuring alignment across Brand, Creative, IMC, Influencer, Commerce, and agency partners. 

  • Champion e.l.f.'s "One Team, One Dream" culture by bringing stakeholders together around shared goals and execution plans. 

Scale Creator-Led Commerce Experiences 

  • Partner with affiliates, agencies, TikTok Shop Partners (TSPs), and influencer teams to deliver engaging, conversion-driving LIVE experiences. 

  • Build creator activation frameworks that connect e.l.f.'s marketing campaigns to social commerce outcomes. 

  • Develop innovative storytelling formats that blend entertainment, education, and commerce. 

Optimize Performance & Growth 

  • Own key LIVE commerce KPIs and reporting including GMV, conversion rate, view duration, CTR, follower growth, engagement, traffic efficiency, and customer acquisition. 

  • Develop testing roadmaps across content, hosts, promotional mechanics, incentives, and traffic strategies. 

  • Analyze viewer behavior and performance data to identify insights, improve operational efficiency, and establish best practices. 

  • Recommend and implement performance-based traffic and incentive packages to maximize ROI. 

Expand Omnichannel Reach 

  • Develop strategies to extend LIVE content beyond TikTok through simulcasting and amplification across e.l.f.'s owned and earned channels, including Instagram, Twitch, and emerging platforms. 

  • Partner with CRM, Beauty Squad, and Connected Commerce teams to create connected customer journeys that extend beyond the LIVE event. 

Innovate for the Future 

  • Stay ahead of emerging trends in social commerce, LIVE shopping, creator ecosystems, and platform innovation. 

  • Pilot new formats, technologies, and platforms that position e.l.f. as a category leader in connected commerce. 

  • Influence the broader social commerce roadmap by identifying scalable opportunities across markets and brands.

• 7+ years of experience in social commerce, LIVE commerce, digital commerce, marketplace management, influencer marketing, or related fields. 

  • Deep expertise in TikTok Shop, LIVE selling, creator ecosystems, and social commerce platforms. 

  • Proven track record scaling revenue-driving commerce programs and managing significant GMV targets. 

  • Strong understanding of merchandising, promotions, pricing strategies, and conversion optimization. 

  • Experience leading cross-functional initiatives across marketing, creative, operations, commerce, and agency partners. 

  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate performance data into actionable business decisions. 

  • Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills. 

  • Experience managing agencies, creators, and external partners. 

  • Global mindset with experience supporting international markets preferred. 

  • Passion for beauty, culture, innovation, and the future of commerce.

TikTok Shop Operations

  • Manage Catalog PIDs and create optimized product listings.
  • Optimize Product Detail Page images and copy specifically for the TikTok platform.
  • Set up shop-wide promotions, maximize platform incentives and opportunities, and proactively monitor and register for TikTok Shop campaigns.
  • Operate the TikTok Shop owner account and ensure all shop setup information remains current. This includes managing access sharing, app syncing, and account settings.
  • Ensure the seller account maintains a high Shop Performance Score by actively monitoring, managing, and troubleshooting violations across the TikTok Shop platform.
  • Oversee platform customer service by responding to messages, monitoring conversations, and managing customer relationship messaging through platform direct messages and customer emails.
  • Monitor and respond to shopper product reviews to drive engagement and build consumer trust.
  • Partner closely with the internal Customer Service team to manage customer communications regarding any order or fulfillment issues.

    • Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Collaborate with distribution partners to provide order uplift forecasts ahead of major events to ensure proper staffing and service level agreement maintenance.
  • Serve as the primary liaison with the Master Data team to ensure items are set up correctly, pricing is accurate, and product statuses are current.
  • Support the Development team in troubleshooting errors impacting the TikTok Shop integration and assist with placing TikTok Shop test orders for User Acceptance Testing across production and development environments.
  • Assist the Accounting team with reconciliation inquiries and coordinate with the external TikTok team when additional support is required.

    • Forecasting, Planning & Reporting

    • Monitor inventory levels to support commerce programs, working closely with Demand and Supply teams to ensure forecasts and replenishments meet digital commerce needs.
    • Review fulfillment metrics daily, oversee comprehensive order management such as returns, refunds, and order cancellations, and communicate any identified issues promptly.
    • Track launch dates, ensure inventory arrives on schedule, and conduct thorough smoke testing of all new items prior to launch.
    • Assist leadership with forecasting pre-work by analyzing past internal data and market insights to inform unit forecasts.
    • Attend sales and operations planning calls, as well as innovation cycle meetings, to review forecasts and ensure demand teams have the necessary information to update dashboards.
    • Manage and update the order forecasting files for North America, adjusting as needed based on program changes.
    • Maintain plan files to ensure dashboards remain accurate and keep comprehensive trackers up to date for promotions, innovation launches, and digital commerce exclusives.

• Experience in social commerce operations, digital commerce, or merchandising, with a strong preference for candidates possessing beauty & personal care or Consumer Packaged Goods industry experience.
  • Proven hands-on experience managing TikTok Shop operations is required, while familiarity with Shopify is considered a strong advantage.
  • Familiarity with order routing and inventory management platforms, such as Pipe17, is a strong advantage.
  • Strong analytical skills with experience using data visualization tools like Power BI and managing complex spreadsheets.
  • Excellent cross-functional communication skills, demonstrating the ability to collaborate effectively with a diverse range of partners.
  • Highly organized with a proven ability to manage multiple trackers, product launches, and operational workflows simultaneously.

lists.content:
Digital Marketing Execution & Campaign Operations
  • Support execution and quality assurance across CRM (Email & SMS), paid media, affiliate, and creator marketing initiatives, ensuring campaigns launch accurately and on schedule.
  • Build, QA, and test all campaigns and automations ensuring flawless execution from setup through deployment.
  • Monitor campaign performance, pacing, budgets, and account health while assisting with day-to-day optimizations and platform maintenance.
  • Support segmentation strategy and execution across email and SMS channels.
  • Set up and monitor A/B tests across email and SMS; synthesize results into clear, actionable recommendations.
  • Build and maintain dashboards, reporting, marketing trackers, and documentation to support business insights and performance analysis.
  • Support affiliate operations, creator gifting, partner communications, and cross- functional coordination to ensure seamless campaign execution.
  • Support post-send performance tracking and contribute to ongoing channel optimization
  • Conduct competitive research, monitor industry trends, and identify opportunities to improve marketing performance and operational efficiency. 
    • Cross-Functional Collaboration & Project Management
  • Coordinate campaign operations, including creative trafficking, project management, testing calendars, audience segmentation, and A/B testing across
    marketing channels.
  • Project manage email and SMS campaigns end-to-end - own the briefing process, coordinate asset delivery timelines, and keep cross-functional partners aligned and
    on schedule.
  • Serve as operational connector to drive digital expression of the brand alongside ecommerce team and cross-functional partners in creative, brand, social, and operations to keep stakeholders aligned, informed, and moving.
  • Partner with ecommerce team on campaign landing pages, promotional & go-to- market execution and inventory alignment, to ensure a seamless customer experience

• 3–5 years of experience in digital marketing, ecommerce, or a related field, ideally within beauty, fashion, CPG, or a DTC brand.
  • Demonstrated experience working cross-functionally across ecommerce, creative, and operations teams in a fast-paced environment.
  • Experience with digital marketing & affiliate platforms such as Shopify, Ads Manager tools (TikTok, Meta, Google), Klaviyo, Postcript, Attentive, LTK, ShopMy, TikTok Shop, GA4 is a plus
  • Strong project management skills with proficiency in tools such as Asana, Figma, or equivalent; able to manage multiple workstreams simultaneously without dropping details.
  • Works independently across a wide range of challenges, selecting the right course of action using evaluation and judgment.
  • Enhances relationships with senior internal and external partners, often through clear communication, proactive updates, and the ability to persuade and influence cross-functionally.

• Location of position: Beverly Hills, CA
  • Hybrid schedule: Must be willing to work at least 3 days a week in the office
  • Budgeted salary: $85K-$100K

lists.content:
Education Strategy & Program Development

  • Support the execution of rhode’s global education strategy by developing scalable programs that support product launches, retail initiatives, and international growth.

  • Create and maintain education tools and resources that deliver a consistent brand and product experience across markets.

  • Identify opportunities to evolve education through innovative formats, tools, and approaches.

    • Product Launch & Education Content

  • Support the development of education for product launches, translating product, ingredient, and brand information into engaging materials, selling tools, and launch resources.

  • Partner with Creative and Product Marketing to develop visually compelling education that reflects rhode’s brand voice and product positioning.

  • Manage education timelines to ensure materials are delivered in alignment with key launch milestones.

    • Field & Retail Support

  • Partner with the Global Field team to support education initiatives, retail execution, and key brand moments across global markets.

  • Support the planning and execution of field conferences, including Sephora Store Manager Conference, training, and other education events.

  • Support the planning and execution of gratis programs for product launches, education initiatives, and retail activations.

  • Gather insights and feedback from the field to inform education content, improve programs, and identify opportunities for innovation.

    • Global Partnerships & Education

  • Partner with international markets, retail partners, and distributors to deliver education that supports successful launches and ongoing business needs.

  • Adapt global education materials for regional audiences while maintaining brand consistency.

  • Gather feedback from the field to continuously improve education programs and experiences.

    • Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with Product Marketing, Product Development, Creative, Commercial, Retail, Field and Customer Experience teams to bring education to life throughout the product launch lifecycle.

  • Measure the effectiveness of education programs and apply insights to improve content, delivery, and the overall experience.

• Bachelor’s degree

  • 3+ years of experience in education, learning and development, retail education, product education, or training within beauty or skincare

  • Experience working with prestige retail partners, including Sephora, is a plus.

  • Familiarity with Sephora education programs, learning platforms, and retail training tools is strongly preferred.

  • Experience supporting global education initiatives or international markets is preferred.

  • Experience developing engaging education content across digital and in-person formats.

  • Strong project management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

  • Exceptional communication and storytelling skills with the ability to simplify complex information.

  • Strong cross-functional collaboration skills and the ability to build relationships across teams.

  • Ability to travel as needed and maintain flexibility to collaborate effectively across international markets and global time zones.

• Reporting to Senior Global Manager, Field, Education & Events 
  • Location of position: preferably NYC based
  • Hybrid schedule: willing to travel to our HQ in Beverly Hills regularly and other locations when needed. 
  • Compensation: $85K-100K

About the Company
 
e.l.f. Beauty's purpose is to make the world a better place for every eye, lip, and face. 
 
Our deep commitment to clean, cruelty free beauty at an incredible value has fueled the success of our flagship brand e.l.f. Cosmetics since 2004 and driven our portfolio expansion. Today, our multi-brand portfolio includes e.l.f. Cosmetics, e.l.f. SKIN, e.l.f. Hair, Well People, Naturium and rhode.
 
In our Fiscal year 26, we had net sales of $1.6 Billion and our business performance has been nothing short of extraordinary with 7 consecutive years of net sales growth. This consistent, category-leading growth is a testament to the strength of our team, strategy, and portfolio of brands. 
 
Our total compensation philosophy offers every full-time new hire competitive pay and benefits, bonus eligibility (200% of target over the last seven fiscal years), equity, flexible time off, year-round half-day Fridays, and a hybrid 3 day in office, 2 day at home work environment. We believe the combination of our unique culture, total compensation, workplace flexibility and care for the team is unmatched across not just beauty but any industry. 
 
Visit our Career Page to learn more about our team: https://www.elfbeauty.com/work-with-us
